resources.string: %1$d address bypass rules · Reconnect to apply
Invalid rules. Tap to fix them.
Choose addresses that bypass the VPN

Listed destinations use the underlying network. Enter one IPv4 or IPv6 address, CIDR subnet, or exact domain per line, or separate the entries with commas.

Valid entries include 192.0.2.0/24, 2001:db8::/32, and example.com. The underlying network resolves domains before connecting and refreshes them on reconnect. Services that share an IP address bypass the VPN together.

Enter domain names without a URL scheme, port, or path. Rules apply to IP traffic from apps on this device. Save and reconnect to apply changes.
